purpose: 用 PG-03 本地回放 Catalog 训练小型 Rule IR 家族解码器，并在来源、漏洞族和可观测表面隔离的测试集上测出口、误报和 abstain。

decision_policy.rule_ir_emission: only after all gates pass and grammar validation succeeds

splits.source_split_same_family: source suffix a trains, suffix b tests
splits.family_holdout_structural_transfer: xss/injection/access_control train; url_redirect/logic test on the same generic registry surface
splits.family_holdout_unseen_surface: xss/injection train; access_control/logic/url_redirect test on an unseen HTTP-canary surface

target_scope.holdout_kind: source, family and observable-surface isolation inside the in-repo local adapter
target_scope.not_claimed: third-party or separately implemented target generalization

metrics.exit_found: predicted family equals the local maze semantic family and a grammar-valid Rule IR is emitted; this is not evaluator confirmation
metrics.false_positive: a non-abstained predicted family differs from the local maze semantic family
metrics.abstain: no family/Rule IR is emitted because confidence, margin, or novelty gate fails
metrics.rule_ir_emission: fraction of test rows with a Rule IR candidate
